question: Which of the following states shares the longest land border with Bangladesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are **five Indian states** that share their** boundary with Bangladesh.** They are - **West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram.**
 
• Indian shares the **longest boundary** with Bangladesh of about **4096 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cd4317a2b8dbdb5cc09cacee27b52de54891b6e6820424e6520d545c313a488.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India has **15,106.7 km of land border **and a **coastline of 7,516.6 km** including island territories.
 
• India shares its land border with seven countries- 
 
 
• **Afghanistan and Pakistan to the North-West, **
 
• **China, Bhutan and Nepal to the North, **
 
• **Bangladesh to the East and**
 
• **Myanmar to the Far East. **
 
 
 
• **Sri Lanka **(from the south-east) and **Maldives** (from the south-west) are two countries with water borders.

 
• Bangladesh

 
 
• Capital – Dhaka
 
• Currency – Bangladeshi Taka
 
• Prime Minister – Sheikh Hasina (March 2022)
